title: The two truncation exact couples
statement:
Let $\square=(f,f',g,g',\alpha)$ be a cartesian square of schemes [def-weil-pbc-cartesian-square], with $f:X\to Y$, $g:Y'\to Y$, $f':X'\to Y'$, $g':X'\to X$, and let $K\in\Dplus(X_{\Et})$ [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]. Put
$$
 \Phi=g^{-1}\circ Rf_*,\qquad\Psi=Rf'_*\circ g'^{-1}:\ \Dplus(X_{\Et})\longrightarrow\Dplus(Y'_{\Et})
$$
(inverse images [def-weil-pbc-derived-inverse-image], derived direct images [def-weil-pbc-direct-image]), with the composite shift isomorphisms $\xi_L:\Phi(L[1])\xrightarrow{\sim}\Phi(L)[1]$ and $\zeta_L:\Psi(L[1])\xrightarrow{\sim}\Psi(L)[1]$ (the identity for $u^{-1}$, the isomorphism $\sigma$ of [lem-weil-pbc-derived-direct-image-triangulated] for $Ru_*$). For $q\in\mathbf Z$ let $\tau_{\leq q}$ be the canonical truncation [def-sbc-standard-tstructure-derived-category] and
$$
 T_q:\quad\tau_{\leq q-1}K\xrightarrow{\,i_q\,}\tau_{\leq q}K\xrightarrow{\,j_q\,}\mathcal H^q(K)[-q]\xrightarrow{\,k_q\,}(\tau_{\leq q-1}K)[1]
$$
the truncation triangle [lem-weil-pbc-truncation-triangle], $\mathcal H^n$ the cohomology sheaves [def-weil-derived-cohomology-sheaves].

*The two truncation exact couples.* For $F\in\{\Phi,\Psi\}$, with $c_F=\xi$ resp. $\zeta$, the *truncation couple of $F$* is $(D_F,E_F,\alpha_F,f_F,g_F)$ in the bidegree convention of [def-sp-exact-couple]:
$$
 D_F^{p,q}=\mathcal H^{p+q}(F\tau_{\leq q}K),\qquad E_F^{p,q}=\mathcal H^{p+q}\bigl(F(\mathcal H^q(K)[-q])\bigr),
$$
$\alpha_F=\mathcal H^{p+q}(Fi_{q+1}):D_F^{p,q}\to D_F^{p-1,q+1}$, $g_F=\mathcal H^{p+q}(Fj_q):D_F^{p,q}\to E_F^{p,q}$, and $f_F:E_F^{p,q}\to D_F^{p+2,q-1}$ the map $\mathcal H^{p+q}(c_{F,\tau_{\leq q-1}K}\circ Fk_q)$ followed by $\mathcal H^{p+q}((F\tau_{\leq q-1}K)[1])=\mathcal H^{p+q+1}(F\tau_{\leq q-1}K)$. Write $(D_A,E_A,\dots)$ for the couple of $\Phi$ and $(D_B,E_B,\dots)$ for that of $\Psi$; in the notation of the blueprint $A_q=\Phi\tau_{\leq q}K$, $G_q=\Phi(\mathcal H^q(K)[-q])$, $B_q=\Psi\tau_{\leq q}K$, $H_q=\Psi(\mathcal H^q(K)[-q])$, and the differential of the first page is $d=g_F\circ f_F:E_F^{p,q}\to E_F^{p+2,q-1}$.

*The exchange morphism of the couples.* It is the pair $t=(t_D,t_E)$ of maps of bigraded sheaves on $Y'_{\Et}$ given by the derived exchange morphisms [def-weil-pbc-derived-exchange] on the terms of $T_q$:
$$
 t_D^{p,q}=\mathcal H^{p+q}(\Ex_{\square,\tau_{\leq q}K}):D_A^{p,q}\to D_B^{p,q},\qquad
 t_E^{p,q}=\mathcal H^{p+q}(\Ex_{\square,\mathcal H^q(K)[-q]}):E_A^{p,q}\to E_B^{p,q}.
$$

That both couples are exact couples, that $t$ is a morphism of exact couples (it commutes with $\alpha$, $f$ and $g$), and that its first graded component $t_E^{p,q}$ is, under the canonical identifications $E_A^{p,q}\cong g^{-1}R^pf_*\mathcal H^q(K)$ and $E_B^{p,q}\cong R^pf'_*g'^{-1}\mathcal H^q(K)$, the degree-$p$ exchange map
$$
 \mathcal H^p(\Ex_{\square,\mathcal H^q(K)}):\ g^{-1}R^pf_*\mathcal H^q(K)\longrightarrow R^pf'_*g'^{-1}\mathcal H^q(K)
$$
of the sheaf $\mathcal H^q(K)$, is [lem-weil-pbc-truncation-couple-morphism].

blueprint_sketch.statement:
For every $q\geq a$, set

$$
\begin{aligned}
A_q&=g^{-1}Rf_*\tau_{\leq q}K,&
G_q&=g^{-1}Rf_*\mathcal H^q(K)[-q],\\
B_q&=Rf'_*g'^{-1}\tau_{\leq q}K,&
H_q&=Rf'_*g'^{-1}\mathcal H^q(K)[-q].
\end{aligned}
$$

The canonical truncation triangle and its exchanged image are

$$
\begin{CD}
A_{q-1}@>{i_q}>>A_q@>{j_q}>>G_q@>{k_q}>>A_{q-1}[1]\\
@V{e_{q-1}}VV@V{e_q}VV@V{\bar e_q}VV@VV{e_{q-1}[1]}V\\
B_{q-1}@>{i'_q}>>B_q@>{j'_q}>>H_q@>{k'_q}>>B_{q-1}[1].
\end{CD}
$$

For total degree $n$, define

$$
\begin{aligned}
D_A^{q,n}&=\mathcal H^n(A_q),&
\mathcal E_A^{p,q}&=\mathcal H^{p+q}(G_q)
=g^{-1}R^pf_*\mathcal H^q(K),\\
D_B^{q,n}&=\mathcal H^n(B_q),&
\mathcal E_B^{p,q}&=\mathcal H^{p+q}(H_q)
=R^pf'_*g'^{-1}\mathcal H^q(K).
\end{aligned}
$$

The exact-couple differential is

$$
d_1=(j_{q-1})_*\circ(k_q)_*:
\mathcal E_A^{p,q}\longrightarrow\mathcal E_A^{p+2,q-1},
$$

and likewise $d'_1=(j'_{q-1})_*(k'_q)_*$. This first
exact-couple page is the page conventionally denoted $E_2$ in the
hypercohomology indexing.

split_report.summary: Checked against the blueprint node (sketch and detailed form) and Stacks Lemma 0DDE (etale-cohomology.tex line 18708, the two spectral sequences of Derived Categories 015J and the map between them, 'some details omitted'). The imported statement made three claims inside the definition (the exchange morphisms on the three terms form a morphism between the couples; the couples are exact couples, implicitly; the first graded component is the degree-p exchange map of H^q(K)). Following the convention that claims inside definitions become statement nodes, the definition now carries only the data, written out: the functors Phi=g^{-1}Rf_*, Psi=Rf'_*g'^{-1} with their shift isomorphisms, the truncation triangles, the two bigraded couples (D_F,E_F,alpha,f,g) in the bidegree convention of def-sp-exact-couple (the blueprint's D^{q,n} indexing translated), and the pair (t_D,t_E); the three claims are the new statement lem-weil-pbc-truncation-couple-morphism, which the definition cites by name for its well-definedness; it is left `unsplit` as a new node, but its proof is already written in 5 steps for the lead's check ( image triangles distinguished; exactness via the long exact cohomology sequence; morphism of triangles from lem-weil-pbc-derived-exchange-triangulated, i.e. naturality of Ex, compatibility with [1] and with the third map; morphism of couples, elementary; identification of t_E with H^p(Ex_{H^q(K)}) by the shift compatibility with n=-q and exactness of g^{-1}). New unsplit nodes: lem-weil-pbc-truncation-triangle (Stacks 08J5) and lem-weil-pbc-derived-direct-image-triangulated (Stacks 05SE/05SU). Removed def-weil-pbc-hypercohomology-filtrations from stmt_deps: the definition does not use it (the import had it under uses_not_cited); relating these couples to the spectral sequences of that node is the business of the nodes that use both.
